findings.text: follow-on: the hand-back writes repair_dispatch for the new round, overwriting the already-opened round's record, and repair_rounds keeps only count/round_id/attempts, so the repair node standing for the first round is no longer discoverable from the pointer the coordinator is handed.

follow-on: the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite/after_suite arm pair, so reckon.crew.review.annotate_review_of_run reads the added-failure count unmeasured; measured 0 added by reviewer arms at the reviewed base and head.
follow-on: the dispatched member of REPAIR_ROUND_OPENING_STATUSES (reckon/crew/recovery.py:936) is never driven, so a round opened by a dispatched repair rather than a resume is not exercised.

item_verdicts.diff: read one landed change at a time against 5b197dc; fe641491 adds the cap and its test, b24d29913 adds the evidence fragment, nothing else.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_one_automatic_repair_round_per_run.py; the run's manifest records that gate at 27 passed, and I reproduced it (27 passed, EXIT=0).
item_verdicts.goal: the goal caps the reflex at one automatic repair round per reviewed run; reckon/crew/recovery.py:2183 hands a later round back to its coordinator instead of opening a second.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records gate 27 passed EXIT=0 and the negative control 1 failed EXIT=1, and its /tmp deletion claim holds.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/recovery.py, the new test file and the evidence fragment; the diff touches exactly those three paths.

justifications.durability: tests/test_one_automatic_repair_round_per_run.py:245 reads the durable pointer and asserts handed_to_coordinator, which reddens when the cap is removed.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_one_automatic_repair_round_per_run.py covers all three done-when cases, but the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite/after_suite arms so its own added-failure count reads unmeasured.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/recovery.py:938 names the record by mechanism and the comments explain the cap without plan or ticket labels.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery.py:2183 records handed-to-coordinator and returns without resuming or dispatching once a round has opened.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff's three paths are exactly the manifest's declared write paths, and ruff check adds no finding to reckon/crew/recovery.py.
